gh "pr" "create" "--base" "main" "--head" "feat/67-system-prompt-files" "--title" "feat: load SYSTEM.md and APPEND_SYSTEM.md into the system prompt" "--body" "Closes #67. Follows #70.

## What changes

- **`SYSTEM.md`** replaces pi's own sections (`preamble`, `tools`, `rules`) with one untagged `preamble` that holds the file's text. The `addendum`, `project_context`, `available_skills`, `cwd`, and extension sections stay.
- **`APPEND_SYSTEM.md`** becomes a tagged `addendum` section between `rules` and `project_context`.
- **Lookup (per file, as in pi):** `<cwd>/.pi/<name>` only with `trust_project: true` and not on a fork pull request; else `<agent_dir>/<name>` when `agent_dir` is set. On forks, `agent_dir` files are skipped too when `agent_dir` is in the workspace.
- **Read once per run.** Invisible characters (BOM too) are removed. A blank file counts as missing, as in pi. Each file is cut at `context_files_max_bytes`, with a warning.
- **New input** `system_prompt_files` (default `true`).
- **Setup log:** `System prompt: .pi/SYSTEM.md (1.2 KiB, replaces pi's base prompt)`, `System prompt: appended agent_dir/APPEND_SYSTEM.md (300 B)`, `System prompt: not loading .pi/SYSTEM.md: trust_project is off` / `…: this pull request comes from a fork`.

## Tests

- `src/system-prompt-files.test.ts`: lookup order (trusted project, then agent_dir, per file), untrusted and fork skipping, invisible characters, the size limit.
- `src/builtin-extension.test.ts`: SYSTEM.md replaces only the base sections; the addendum comes right after `rules`.
- `src/run.test.ts`: end to end with `trust_project`, without it, and with `system_prompt_files: false`.

## Docs

`docs/prompts.md` (new "System prompt files" section and the section list), `docs/security.md`, `docs/extensions.md`, README inputs, CONTRIBUTING source table.

`npm run check` passes."
